name: Pizza e Birra
notes: Restaurant's own domain (pizzaebirrasandiego.com) is behind an sgcaptcha bot wall on every request (same signature as Mi Ranchito - both redirect to /.well-known/sgcaptcha/ - likely shared hosting/security vendor), so the Slice storefront linked from search results was used instead. Address in the page's schema.org Restaurant JSON-LD matches work list exactly (3625 India St). No Menu JSON-LD was present (only Restaurant + BreadcrumbList), so the menu itself came from the __SLICE_REDUX_STATE__ blob, parsed by balancing braces from the 'window.__SLICE_REDUX_STATE__=' assignment (not regex-matched to a closing tag, per the __OO_STATE__ lesson) - menus.menus[key].value.categories[].groupedProducts[].productTypes[] gives per-size prices. Ran the markup test on the full non-catering menu (89 items): checked 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/0.96 - the highest hit rate (1.25, 33.7%) traced to a coincidental cluster of unrelated pizzas sharing the common $23.75 Small / $28.75 Large base price points, not a uniform divisor - only 22 of 51 pizza rows landed exactly on a round number under that divisor and the rest (mostly the very same 'Large' size at $26.75) did not, which is the opposite of the 'near-zero exceptions' signature the playbook flags as a real fee. No divisor cleared with the required near-total hit rate, so treated as ordinary independent per-item pricing, not a markup. A 'Top Five Items' section duplicated 6 items already listed under their real categories (Wings, Calabrese Pizza, Lasagna, Poached Pear Salad, Meat Lovers Calzone) - 3 of the 6 carried a slightly different price there (e.g. Lasagna $17.50 in Pastas vs $18.25 in Top Five Items, Poached Pear Salad $13.50 vs $16.25) with no consistent ratio between the two, so rather than guessing which is canonical, the section was dropped entirely and only the category-listed price was kept for each - noting the discrepancy here rather than filing a second row. Catering trays (Salads Catering, Pastas Catering) excluded as adjunct. Reached categories: Shareables, Salads, Pizza, Artisan Pizza, Baked Sandwiches, Pastas, Desserts, Calzones, Beverages. Not reached/excluded: Top Five Items (duplicate carousel, see above), Salads Catering, Pastas Catering (adjunct).
